How we know

The club’s 2026 Saturday schedule PDF (as of 3/30/26, posted April 2026) lists Oct 3 at 9:00 AM (Bridge to Ridge routes) and Oct 10 at 9:00 AM (‘week to week as weather allows’), with 8:00 AM starts from June through mid-September.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:00 am. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
Expect 6–18 mph: you can talk the whole way. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host’s website the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Mountain State Wheelers Saturday Ride group ride

Mountain State Wheelers Saturday Ride is a road group ride in Charleston, WV. It rolls every Saturday at 9:00 am.

The Charleston area road club’s Saturday ride. Start point and route change each week on a published schedule, with Elkview, Winfield, Milton and Alum Creek regulars. Ride categories run from beginner to advanced.
